cases.question: What text can PaperParse extract from digital PDFs?

criteria.requirement: State that PaperParse extracts embedded text from digital PDFs.

forbidden_assertions: PaperParse requires OCR for every digital PDF.

doc_1.title: PaperParse: input support
doc_1.text: PaperParse is a fictional library. It extracts embedded text from digital PDFs. Scanned PDFs require the optional ScanBridge OCR integration.

doc_2.title: PaperParse: tables and OCR limitations
doc_2.text: PaperParse extracts tables from digital PDFs. With ScanBridge, it can process scanned tables, but merged cells and low-quality scans may require manual correction.

doc_3.title: VisionPages: capabilities and limitations
doc_3.text: VisionPages is a fictional library with built-in OCR for scanned PDFs and table extraction. Its documentation reports difficulty with handwritten text and tables spanning pages.
